frozen_claim.lemma: If X is a boundaryless manifold, f:X->X is proper, compact-support cohomology is finite-dimensional, and f has no fixed points, then L_c(f)=0.
frozen_claim.proof_step: Choose a compactly supported Thom class of the diagonal supported in an arbitrarily small neighborhood of the noncompact diagonal.
frozen_claim.downstream_use: Deduce that a fixed-point-free deck transformation cannot act on one-dimensional top compact-support cohomology.

expert_counterexample.map_family: f_q(x)=x+q for any nonzero rational q
